readiness.hed: Fredericksburg stays mild and mostly cloudy near 67 this afternoon, turns damp overnight with a slight rain chance, then a steadier rain system soaks Sunday into Sunday night before a mostly sunny, milder Monday near 70
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this afternoon. Today holds mostly cloudy near 67, falling to around 61 by evening, with light east winds, and tonight brings only a slight 20 percent rain chance with a low near 50. Sunday turns wetter, with an 80 percent chance of rain and a high near 64, continuing into Sunday night with a 60 percent chance and a low near 50 as the system moves through, with a quarter to half inch of rain possible across the two days. Monday clears out mostly sunny and a few degrees milder, near 70, before temperatures drop again Monday night to a low near 36.
actions: Sunday's steadier rain is the best bet of the weekend for washing out any outdoor plans — shift yard work, errands or a church outdoor event to today or Monday instead.
Tonight's slight rain chance is light enough to skip extra prep, but it's a good night to double-check gutters and drains before Sunday's heavier rain arrives.
Sunday night's continued rain chance means a wet Monday morning commute is possible even though Monday itself clears up — leave extra time and expect standing water on low-lying roads.
Monday's near-70 high is a good window for any outdoor chores before colder air returns Monday night, with lows back down near 36.
